name: Demis Hassabis
summary: AI researcher and founder combining neuroscience, machine learning and game design. Leads teams that apply deep reinforcement learning to scientific problems such as protein structure prediction.

education.thesis: Neural Mechanisms of Episodic Memory and Imagination

children: Leading the research and development of general-purpose AI systems through deep reinforcement learning.
Spearheaded breakthroughs like AlphaGo, which defeated a professional Go player.
Directed the development of AlphaFold, solving the protein-folding grand challenge.
Orchestrating the fusion of large-scale compute, biology, and deep learning.
Managing the integration of DeepMind into Google's core AI ecosystem.
Leading a world-class team of researchers, engineers, and scientists.
Driving the research agenda for the next generation of artificial general intelligence.
Establishing DeepMind as the global leader in transformative AI research.
Developed highly advanced AI for commercial video games, demonstrating early expertise in agentic behavior.
Conducted research in neuroscience and cognitive psychology to inform AI development.
Built highly successful game-based AI architectures.

projects.title: AlphaFold
projects.subtitle: Deep Learning for Biology
bullets: Developed an AI system capable of predicting the 3D structure of proteins from their amino acid sequences.
Solved a 50-year-old grand challenge in biology with unprecedented accuracy.
Accelerated drug discovery and biological research globally through open access to protein structures.
Integrated deep learning with geometric and physical constraints to ensure biological plausibility.

projects.title: AlphaGo
projects.subtitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning
bullets: Created the first AI system to master the game of Go, demonstrating superhuman strategic capability.
Combined deep neural networks with Monte Carlo tree search to solve complex decision-making tasks.
Proved the effectiveness of deep reinforcement learning in highly complex environments.

activities.title: AI Research Leadership
activities.subtitle: Global Scientific Community
bullets: Advocating for the safe and beneficial development of AGI.
Collaborating with biologists and chemists to apply AI to scientific discovery.
Promoting interdisciplinary research between neuroscience and computer science.
